For any set $S$, we have $|P(S)|={2}^{|S|}.$ 

In our case, we have $|B|=2.$ Therefore, we obtain

$$
|P(B)|={2}^{2}=4.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}|P(P(B))| & ={2}^{|P(B)|} \\  & ={2}^{4} \\  & =16.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|P(P(P(B)))| & ={2}^{|P(P(B))|} \\  & ={2}^{16} \\  & =65\,536.\end{aligned}
$$
